item.title: EplayerX 1.2.31
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 修复网盘和网络共享文件列表的列排序，切换排序后及时刷新。 - 媒体库支持批量清除匹配记录、删除受支持来源的原始文件，并改进海报显示、选择与返回操作。 - 优化播放中的字幕调整，使针对当前内容的设置更独立，减少影响其他影片。 - 改善字幕翻译与双字幕的配合，修复取消 AI 字幕后普通字幕可能被自动恢复的问题。 - 优化继续观看的播放地址复用、弹幕请求和缓存管理。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Fixed column sorting in cloud-drive and network-share file lists, with prompt refreshes when the sort order changes. - Added batch removal of matching records and original files from supported sources, with improved poster display, selection, and back navigation in the media library. - Improved subtitle adjustments during playback so settings for the current title are more independent and less likely to affect other titles. - Improved cooperation between subtitle translation and dual subtitles, and fixed ordinary subtitles being restored automatically after cancelling AI subtitles. - Improved playback-address reuse for Continue Watching, danmaku requests, and cache management.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
